notes: Membership is a judgment against the WotC definition in the source. A card qualifies when one effect removes, locks, or changes the mana of four or more lands of one player without replacement. The list leaves out single-land removal (Strip Mine) and effects that replace the lands (From the Ashes, Wave of Vitriol). It also leaves out effects under four lands (Ember Swallower) and cards banned in Commander (Upheaval). Cards that hit every land of one basic type (Boil) qualify against most decks, so the list keeps them. The candidates come from Scryfall searches of Oracle text (legal:commander) on 2026-09-13. Scryfall confirms every name as an exact Oracle name on the same date. The lists at commanderbrackets.com and EDHREC serve as a comparison, not as the source.
